name: Auth0 MCP
description: Lets agents manage an Auth0 tenant over a local MCP server, creating applications, APIs, and Actions, reading logs, and onboarding projects, with device-flow sign-in.

skills.name: Application Management
skills.description: Lists, creates, and updates Auth0 applications, and saves an application's credentials to a project's .env file.

skills.name: Project Onboarding
skills.description: Creates an Auth0 application configured for a given framework, saves its credentials, and returns SDK integration code.

skills.name: Actions Deployment
skills.description: Lists, creates, updates, and deploys Auth0 Actions in the connected tenant from natural-language prompts.

skills.name: APIs And Grants
skills.description: Creates and updates resource servers (APIs) and client grants that authorize an application to call an API with scopes.

skills.name: Tenant Logs
skills.description: Lists tenant logs and fetches a log entry by ID, with tool access narrowed by the --read-only and --tools flags.
